title: Responding in Defender XDR (1): Office 365, Purview, Cloud and Cloud Apps

header.html: Investigate and remediate threats by using Microsoft Defender for Office 365, including automatic attack disruption; investigate and remediate threats or compromised entities identified by Microsoft Purview; investigate and remediate alerts and incidents identified by Microsoft Defender for Cloud workload protections; investigate and remediate security risks identified by Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
the official Microsoft SC-200 study guide (skills measured as of October 21, 2026) and Microsoft Learn

toc.title: Defender for Office 365: where to investigate

html:
1Defender for Office 365: where to investigate

Tool Plan Notes
Real-time detections Plan 1 Default view Malware; no Go hunt, no URL clicks view
Threat Explorer Plan 2 Default view All email; adds Campaigns, URL clicks, Go hunt, saved queries
Date filter Both Default yesterday and today; up to 30 days back; export up to 200,000 rows

Plan 1 adds Safe Attachments, Safe Links, anti-phishing impersonation protection and real-time detections. Plan 2 adds Threat Explorer, Threat Trackers, Campaigns, attack simulation training, priority account protection and automated investigation and response.

Exam tip

. Real-time detections = Plan 1. Threat Explorer = Plan 2. If a question needs Campaigns or URL clicks, the answer is Plan 2.

2Take action on email

In Threat Explorer, select messages and choose Take action.

Action Plan
Move or delete: Junk, Inbox, Deleted items, Soft deleted items, Hard deleted items Plan 2
Release quarantined messages Plan 2
Initiate automated investigation Plan 2
Propose remediation (creates a pending soft-delete that another admin approves in the Action center: two-step approval) Plan 2
Submit to Microsoft for review; Allow or block entries in the Tenant Allow/Block List Plan 1 and 2
Fact Detail
Soft delete Moves to Recoverable Items\Deletions; the user or admin can recover
Hard delete Purge; admins can recover only with single item recovery
Roles Search and Purge to move or delete; Preview to preview or download; Security Reader is read-only
Large selections Over 100 entries allow only limited actions

3Zero-hour auto purge (ZAP)

ZAP retroactively acts on messages already delivered when new intelligence marks them bad. It looks at email from the last 48 hours in cloud mailboxes.

Verdict ZAP result
Malware Quarantined (read or unread)
High confidence phishing Quarantined
Phishing (not high confidence) Follows the anti-spam policy; default Move to Junk; Standard and Strict presets quarantine
Spam Only unread messages; default Move to Junk

To see ZAP actions: Threat Explorer > All email > Additional action = ZAP.

Exam tip

. Malware and high-confidence phishing go to quarantine; ordinary spam goes to Junk.

4Microsoft Purview

If you have Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management provisioned, its alerts appear in the Defender portal, and you can hunt insider risk events there. Hunting tables DataSecurityEvents and DataSecurityBehaviors hold user activities that violate Purview policies. Share endpoint alerts with the Microsoft Compliance Center (Module 2) so that Purview solutions receive device signals.

Response pattern: open the incident, review the user and the activity, then contain the account in Defender or Entra (reset password, revoke sessions, disable) and let the Purview case handle the policy side.

5Defender for Cloud workload protections

Fact Detail
Prerequisite Defender for Cloud enabled on the Azure subscription
Access The unified RBAC role for Defender for Cloud; without RBAC you must be Global Administrator or Security Administrator
Informational alerts Not brought into the Defender portal
Status sync Defender for Cloud alerts sync both ways; Defender for Endpoint alerts on cloud resources do not sync status
Where you see them Cloud resources appear in the incident Assets tab and in the attack story
Hunting tables CloudAuditEvents, CloudProcessEvents, CloudStorageAggregatedEvents
Sentinel connector Use the tenant-based Defender for Cloud (preview) connector; disconnect the legacy subscription-based connector to avoid duplicates

In Defender for Cloud, an alert's Take action tab offers mitigation steps, prevention steps, automated response with a Logic App workflow and suppression.

6Defender for Cloud Apps

Policy type Use
Anomaly detection Machine learning alerts; tune the sensitivity slider, scope to user groups
OAuth app Alert on risky or over-privileged apps (for example an app used by more than 100 users)
Activity Alert on activities such as access from unexpected locations
Session (Conditional Access app control) Monitor or block downloads on unmanaged or risky devices
Governance action Effect
Suspend user, Require user to sign in again Contain the account in the app
Confirm user compromised Sets the user risk to high
Revoke app permissions or Ban app (OAuth) Removes a risky OAuth app
Put in user or admin quarantine, Remove external users, Make private File actions

Results appear in Cloud Apps > Governance log. When actions conflict, the stronger action is enforced. File policies retire on January 6, 2027; move to Purview DLP or auto-labeling.

Exam tip

. Compromised OAuth app = revoke or ban the app. Compromised user = confirm compromised, suspend or require sign-in again.

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A phishing campaign delivered the same message to 300 mailboxes. An analyst with Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 needs to delete them from the mailboxes. What should be used?

  • AReal-time detections with the Go hunt option
  • BThe Tenant Allow/Block List with an allow entry for the sender
  • CThreat Explorer, Take action, then Move or delete
  • DA Defender for Cloud Apps session policy
Show the answer

Answer: C. Threat Explorer (Plan 2) lets you move or delete messages with Take action; the Search and Purge role is needed.

S2A customer has only Defender for Office 365 Plan 1. Which view shows recent detections of malware and phishing in near real time?

  • AThreat Explorer, which is available only with Plan 2
  • BCampaigns, which is available only with Plan 2
  • CAttack simulation training, which is a Plan 2 feature
  • DReal-time detections, which is available with Plan 1
Show the answer

Answer: D. Plan 1 includes real-time detections; Threat Explorer and Campaigns need Plan 2.

S3Zero-hour auto purge finds a delivered message that is now known to be high-confidence phishing. What does ZAP do?

  • AMoves the message to the Junk Email folder
  • BHard deletes the message from the mailbox
  • CMoves the message to quarantine
  • DLeaves the message and adds a warning banner
Show the answer

Answer: C. ZAP quarantines malware and high-confidence phishing.

S4An admin soft deletes a malicious message from a mailbox. Where can the item still be recovered from?

  • AThe Purges folder in the mailbox of the user
  • BThe Recoverable Items\Deletions folder
  • CThe quarantine of the Tenant Allow/Block List
  • DThe Action center history with the undo button
Show the answer

Answer: B. Soft delete moves items to Recoverable Items\Deletions; hard delete purges them.

S5An analyst investigates suspicious activity on Kubernetes workloads and wants process-level hunting data from Defender for Cloud. Which table fits?

  • AEmailEvents, the table of delivered messages
  • BCloudProcessEvents, the table of cloud process events
  • CIdentityLogonEvents, the table of identity sign-ins
  • DDeviceNetworkEvents, the table of outgoing device network connections
Show the answer

Answer: B. CloudProcessEvents holds process events for platforms protected by Defender for Containers.

S6A user consented to a risky OAuth app that reads mail. Which Defender for Cloud Apps action removes the threat?

  • ARevoke the app permissions or ban the app
  • BPut the mailbox files in admin quarantine
  • CApply a sensitivity label to every attachment
  • DMake all the shared files private for the user
Show the answer

Answer: A. Revoking OAuth app permissions or banning the app removes the risky app's access.

7.2 Recall questions

R1Which plan includes Threat Explorer?

Show the answer

Defender for Office 365 Plan 2.

R2What role is needed to move or delete messages?

Show the answer

Search and Purge.

R3How far back does ZAP look?

Show the answer

The last 48 hours of delivered email.

R4Which governance action sets user risk to high?

Show the answer

Confirm user compromised.

R5Where is the Defender for Cloud Apps governance log?

Show the answer

Cloud Apps > Governance log.

R6When do Cloud Apps file policies retire?

Show the answer

January 6, 2027.

8Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Plan 1 Real-time detections, Safe Links, Safe Attachments
Plan 2 Threat Explorer, Campaigns, URL clicks, AIR, Take action, attack simulation
Take action Move or delete, release, investigate, propose remediation; Search and Purge role
ZAP 48 hours; malware and high-confidence phishing to quarantine
Defender for Cloud tables CloudAuditEvents, CloudProcessEvents, CloudStorageAggregatedEvents
Cloud Apps anomaly, OAuth, activity and session policies; governance log
